payload.claim: `witness_blocking`'s docstring asserts as current fact: "Nothing reads it yet, and the thing that will currently disagrees... `session._blocking`... gains only `size` at non-elevated tiers — so a `witness` failure blocks at `standard` today, the opposite of what this returns." This diff is exactly the reconciliation the docstring describes as not-yet-done: `session._suite` now calls `witness_blocking(cast(RiskTier, current_tier))` and adds `witness` to `advisory_gates` at non-elevated tiers, so `session._blocking` no longer disagrees at any tier. Because `saffron/gates/**` is forbidden to this spec, nobody updated this docstring, so it now makes a false claim about the codebase's state that a future reader of `contract.py` (or of `docs/BACKLOG.md` item 71, which this docstring points to) would be misled by.
